description: This file defines controller functions for managing evaluators in a web application, including CRUD operations, using Express.js framework.

methods.name: getAllEvaluators
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to retrieve all evaluators with pagination, based on user's active workspace.

methods.name: getEvaluator
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to retrieve a specific evaluator by ID within user's active workspace.

methods.name: createEvaluator
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to create a new evaluator with data from request body.

methods.name: updateEvaluator
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to update an existing evaluator identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteEvaluator
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to delete an evaluator by ID.
